models.title: AdventureWorks OLTP
models.description: The ModelSpec for Microsoft's AdventureWorks OLTP sample, derived from the pinned SQL Server 2025 sample installer fixture. It describes the source tables and properties as a reusable model for copies of this database.

models.title: Chinook music store
models.description: The data model of the Chinook sample database: a digital music store with artists, albums, tracks, playlists, customers, employees and invoices, as 11 entities whose names are the upstream table and column names. Anything that stores Chinook, such as a SQLite file, a CSV export or an OpenVaultDB database, is a copy of this model.

models.title: Employees (browser edition)
models.description: The ModelSpec for a reproducible browser-sized edition of the MySQL Employees sample. It describes the six native tables and their declared primary and composite keys without inventing identities.

models.title: GeoNames source projection
models.description: Source-faithful model for four logical GeoNames recordsets: countries, places, admin1 and alternate names. Native text fields, keys and unresolved references remain available; auxiliary demo country bridge entities retain separate source property scopes. Model metadata is CC0-1.0; source data is CC-BY-4.0. Registration alone does not authorize raw-label interoperability.

models.title: Northwind small-business database
models.description: The data model of the classic Northwind sample database: customers, employees, orders, products, suppliers and related tables. Its entities and properties describe the pinned upstream SQLite schema; any copy of Northwind uses this model.

models.title: Pubs publishing database
models.description: The classic Microsoft Pubs sample model covers authors, publications, publishers, stores, sales and employees. It preserves all 11 native tables, including keyless discounts and royalty schedules without fabricated identity.

models.title: Research Organization Registry source projection
models.description: Source-faithful ROR schema 2 model: organizations preserve native URL identity, status and original JSON; locations and relationships retain source array ordinals as physical projections of one logical organizations recordset. Model metadata is CC0-1.0; embedded GeoNames data remains CC-BY-4.0 under the provider attribution. Registration does not authorize a user identifier mapping.

models.title: Sakila video rental sample
models.description: The MySQL Sakila sample model for films, actors, customers, rentals, payments, stores and staff, represented by its 16 native table entities.
